newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU probes German aid to Bremer Vulkan companies.
newsitem.headline: EU probes German aid to Bremer Vulkan companies.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it was challenging rescue aid worth 35 million deutschemarks given by the German authorities to Neptun Industrie Rostock and Dieselmoterenwerk Vulkan, both of which were part of Bremer Vulkan before its bankruptcy.

"In the light of the fragmented information at its disposal at the moment the Commission has doubts about these aids' compatibility with the single market and is asking the German authorities to provide all the information necessary so that the Commission can examine them," the Commission said in a statement.
The Commission said it had examined the aid in the light of EU guidelines on rescue and restructuring aid.
Neptun Industrie is involved in the mechanical construction business and Dieselmoterenwerk makes diesel motors for shipyards.
